verdict.rationale: AutoGen ships conventional static docs and tutorials (autogen-docs-1..22) but no evidence of an interactive, runnable API reference (e.g., embedded live code execution, Jupyter-style sandbox tied to reference pages); probes confirm no llms.txt, no markdown-served docs, and no OpenAPI spec (autogen-probe-1,2,3), indicating the docs are not AI-native/interactive in the way the story describes.
